notes:
Lead: QueryFlux (customer-facing KB for multiple SaaS products). Very focused on embeddings + reranking pipeline to improve KB answer precision at high QPS. Wants hosted API to avoid ops overhead but needs strict latency and cost modeling. 
- Demo 2024-11-12: live Q&A with AE/SE; showed Redwood hosted API + rerank config. Customer: 'we need sub-100ms p50 for top-k rerank, p99 under 400ms ideally' (quote).
- Pain: current stack (vector DB + external cross-encoder) has variable latency at peak; cost per query too high when cross-encoder runs on every candidate. Looking for hybrid: bi-encoder candidate recall from embeddings + low-latency cross-encoder rerank only top-10.
- Data scale: currently ~1.2M KB fragments (articles/snippets), expect growth 3-4x in 12 months. Indexing cadence: daily delta + backfill quarterly.
- Cost sensitivity: Mid-high; willing to pay for reliability but wants clear per-query cost model + batching recommendations.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO with SAML, region: NA-only data residency for customer data. Wants KMS integration and retention controls.
- Quote from head of infra: 'If Redwood can deliver 200-500 sustained QPS with stable p95 under 200ms for retrieval+rerank, we can consolidate and drop one vendor.'

use_case_summary: SaaS customer knowledge base search using hybrid retrieval: dense embeddings for recall + lightweight cross-encoder reranker for precision. High-read QPS (bursty up to hundreds/sec), daily index updates, aim to replace multi-vendor pipeline with single hosted inference flow.
performance_targets: High QPS: sustained 200-500 QPS with bursts to 1k for short windows; retrieval+rerank end-to-end p50 < 80ms, p95 < 200ms, p99 < 400ms; SLA uptime 99.95% for production endpoints.
indexing_estimates: Current corpus ~1.2M fragments (~120GB text). Expected to grow to 4M fragments in 12 months. Ingest cadence: daily deltas (~10k new fragments/day). Typical query footprint: short context retrieval + rerank top-10 candidates.
tech_requirements: Hosted API preferred. Needs per-request routing control to use cheaper bi-encoder for low-confidence queries and full cross-encoder when confidence threshold crosses. KV/prefix caching for repeated queries desirable. Integrations: SSO (SAML), KMS, audit logs export to customer SIEM; retention controls + option for NA-only data residency.
poc_success_criteria: 1) Baseline throughput: 200 QPS sustained for 2 hours with <200ms p95; 2) Cost model: projected monthly cost < current vendor spend at projected scale; 3) Security checklist: SOC2 docs + SAML SSO test completed; 4) Indexing: daily delta ingestion completes within 30 minutes; 5) Qualitative: answer relevance improves top-1 accuracy by 12-18% on internal eval set.
commercial_notes: Initial ARR target $80k-$200k; customer prefers annual commitment after successful POC. Procurement timeline aggressive if POC passes - target contracting by 2025-03.
open_questions: 1) Which reranker model family yields the best latency/quality tradeoff on their data? (we recommended distilled cross-encoders); 2) Can we expose cost-per-call heuristic in Console to let them tune thresholds?; 3) TLS + KMS key ownership model for hosted API (bring-your-own-key?)
